newsitem.title: USA: NetVantage sees Q4 oper net below forecast.
newsitem.headline: NetVantage sees Q4 oper net below forecast.

text.p: NetVantage Inc Monday said fourth quarter operating profits are not expected to meet its previous forecast of $0.07 a share.
In a statement, the company said the quarter will be hurt by higher expenses.

The company said because of faster than expected escalation of sales of its workgroup switching products, sales and gross profit margins for the December quarter will likely be higher than was anticipated earlier in the fall.

It also said certain expenses for the December quarter will be higher than anticipated principally due to selling and marketing expense associated with commission structures that award accelerated commission rates for sales above a salesperson's sales quota. The commission structures are to be revised in January.
Also contributing to these expenses in the quarter are the company's increased investments in research and development to support its expanding customer base, the company added.

NetVantage President and Chief Executive Officer Stephen Rizzone said net income for the December quarter would be negatively affected by the added expense. He said fourth quarter earnings are unlikely to meet the previous forecast of $0.07 a share prior to a previously announced $4.1 million accounting charge.
In the year ago quarter, the company posted a loss of $2.2 million or $0.90 a share.

Separately, the company said it has received orders to supply the company's WorkGroup Switches to an unidentified original equipment manufacturer totaling about $4 million, with shipments starting next month.
